Hooli Pay — App Install Campaign Report Q3 2026

Period: July 1 to September 30, 2026. Prepared by Acme Digital for the Hooli Pay Growth team. All amounts in Mexican pesos (MXN). Installs are measured with the mobile measurement partner and deduplicated across channels.

Executive summary

  • Total installs: 186,400, up 34% from Q2 2026.
  • Total spend: MXN 7,920,000, for a blended CPI of MXN 42.49.
  • 58% of new installs completed KYC (INE upload plus selfie) and opened a verified account.
  • 31,200 Hooli Card requests came from users acquired this quarter.

Meta brought 45% of all installs, Google 39% and TikTok 16%. TikTok had the highest cost per install of the quarter, MXN 50.50.

Retention

  • Blended day-7 retention was 41% and day-30 retention was 23%.
  • Google App campaigns retained best, with 27% of users still active on day 30; TikTok users retained worst at 16%.
  • Users who finished KYC within their first 24 hours had 38% day-30 retention.

KYC and activation funnel

  • 79% of installs registered, and 81% of registered users started KYC.
  • 90% of users who started KYC finished it; 62% of the abandonments happened at the selfie step.
  • 44% of verified users made their first transaction within 7 days, most often a phone top-up or a utility bill payment.

Creatives that worked

  • "Paga tus servicios en 3 taps", a 15-second UGC video, was the best performer on Meta with a CPI of MXN 34.10.
  • The static carousel "Tu tarjeta sin anualidad" drove the highest card-request rate: 21% of verified users who saw it requested the card.
  • TikTok creator duets reached a 1.9% CTR, but those users churned faster than average.
  • Generic lifestyle stock footage ran above MXN 60 per install and was paused on August 12.

Recommendations for Q4

  • Move 10% of the TikTok budget to Google App campaigns.
  • Refresh UGC creatives every 3 weeks to avoid fatigue.
  • Test a referral campaign, "Invita y gana MXN 100", before El Buen Fin.
